events.subtitle: Future Soul 2026 Tour
events.factual_description: Wolf Trap presents Tedeschi Trucks Band's Future Soul 2026 Tour with Lukas Nelson at the Filene Center on Friday and Saturday, August 28-29, 2026, with both shows at 7:00 PM and gates at 5:30 PM. Wolf Trap identifies Tedeschi Trucks Band as a 12-member ensemble led by Susan Tedeschi and Derek Trucks and frames its live language around soul, blues, roots and rock; Lukas Nelson opens with material including his album American Romance. The tour announcement from Live Nation identifies the complete 12-person Tedeschi Trucks Band lineup and confirms both Wolf Trap dates as part of the broad 2026 Future Soul tour. Wolf Trap currently shows August 28 on sale and August 29 sold out.

en.why_it_matters: The draw is the band architecture as much as the two names at the front. Tedeschi and Trucks put two very different guitar voices inside a 12-piece ensemble with twin drums, horns, keyboards and layered vocals, so blues and roots-rock can open into soul, gospel color and long-form improvisation without losing the song. Future Soul is also current material rather than a catalog victory lap, and Lukas Nelson gives the evening another live roots vocabulary without breaking the musical through-line.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the Wolf Trap nights if the DMV calendar allows it; August 28 is the practical target because August 29 is currently sold out. The long national tour and two-night local run give enough flexibility that this should not displace a genuinely rare premiere, farewell or one-off.

es.why_it_matters: Aquí el atractivo está tanto en la arquitectura de la banda como en los dos nombres al frente. Tedeschi y Trucks meten dos voces de guitarra muy distintas dentro de un ensamble de 12 músicos con doble batería, metales, teclados y varias voces; por eso el blues y el roots rock pueden abrirse hacia soul, color gospel e improvisación larga sin perder la canción. Future Soul además es material actual, no una vuelta de catálogo, y Lukas Nelson suma otro vocabulario de raíces sin romper el hilo musical de la noche.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a una de las noches de Wolf Trap si el calendario del DMV lo permite; el 28 de agosto es el objetivo práctico porque el 29 aparece agotado. La gira nacional extensa y las dos fechas locales dan margen suficiente para no desplazar por esto un estreno, despedida o one-off verdaderamente raro.
